Background:
- Founded 2019, mid-market e‑commerce platform (personalization + chat) serving ~20M MAU.
- Performance critical: checkout assist + fraud-detect reranking must run at low-latency to avoid conversion impact.
Key ask from CTO: "we need consistent <50ms p95 for short chat / rerank paths at peak traffic". Cost sensitivity: narrow unit-cost targets to keep margins on recommendation flows.
Technical reqs / preferences:
- Workload: high-QPS short chats (avg 6-12 tokens response), product-reranking (embeddings + rerank), session-based context with KV caching.
- Latency target: p95 <= 50ms (goal 30-40ms) for chat quick-responses; throughput target 8k-15k qps for peak sale events.
- Cost: target reduce per-call token cost ~30% vs current hosted provider by using batching + quantization + prefix caching.
- Model preference: open LLM family (Llama-derivative acceptable) with 8-bit quantization; fallback to smaller 7B variant for burst windows.
- Routing/fallback: require policy to route to dedicated pool or fallback to lower-cost region/variant when Dedicated capacity saturated.
- Observability: per-route p95, token-cost, and token-breakdown; need tracing links to request ids and ability to tie regressions to prompt sets.
- Security: VPC + SSO (SAML), KMS integration and audit logs, data residency in NA.
Interest in Redwood features:
- Redwood Optimize: want batching/caching profile suggestions and quantization recommendations per workload slice.
- Perf benchmarking: request Redwood perf harness to run benchmarks across model variants and sequence-length distributions; include cold/warm KV cache runs.
- Rollouts: want canary + automatic fallback.

- SE noted initial perf estimate: Dedicated with 2 x A100 equiv pools + autoscale burst to handle flash sales.

- 2-week Dedicated POC: realistic traffic replay (synthetic + sampled prod), measure p50/p95/p99, cost per 1M tokens, evaluate prefix/KV caching hit-rate improvement, and assess int8 quantization impact on latency and quality.
- Deliverables: perf report, Optimize tuning recommendations, sample rollout policy manifest.
